title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
keywords: Selection for higher education / employment 2.Self-analysis and self-development 3.Conducting corporate research 4.Examination preparation
educationalGoal: This course is for an educational goal of the Department of Management Systems to acquire "Career Planning". Students will: (1) confirm the learning style including self-study, and get ready to become a human resource who can stand up by yourself and contribute to society, (2) Recognize your ability and personality correctly, continue self-development, improve self-management ability and continue to strive for self-realization.
advice: This class is conducted in departmental units. (1) Guidance (2) Experiences of senior and graduate students (3) Self-appeal sheet description method (4) Various mock tests (5) Interview guidance (6) Talks from local company employment managers and alumni
requiredKnowledge: Career seminars I and II, which are held in the 1st semester and the 2nd semester, are mainly courses for job hunting. All students should take these courses whether you are going to plan taking Master’s degree or getting a job. The results of this study will be a reference material for job placement.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the activity process from career path selection to decision.
Be able to collect and analyze information necessary for higher education and employment and develop voluntary.
Be able to sustain self-study toward higher aptitude, scholastic ability, etc. required by higher-grade students

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
